entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely useless cycling shoes I bought. This is completely unacceptable.

I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with them. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's a fault with your terrible design! They've given me the worst blisters I've ever had. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, and it doesn't help. They're just garbage. I want a refund, and I want it now!
I understand your frustration, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order details. Could I get your name or order number, please?

The name is Alex Chen. And you better resolve this, because if I don't get my money back, I swear I will write a review on every single website I can find. This is ridiculous. I want to speak to your manager!
I'm confident I can resolve this for you, Alex, there's no need to escalate. Just one moment... Okay, I see your order for the cycling shoes from about two months ago, 66 days to be exact.
So what? Are you going to tell me it's been too long? Because I will lose it.
Not at all. I was just confirming the date. According to our VeloFit return policy, you are well within the 90-day window for a return. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh. Really? A full refund? No restocking fee or some other nonsense?

That's correct, a full refund. I am emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just package the shoes, attach the label, and drop them off. As soon as we receive them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Huh. Okay. Well... that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Alex. Have a wonderful day.
